text:
lucy: Quick RFC follow-up: proposing a tiny routing/telemetry sidecar (working name: slim-router) to dedupe hotpath bits across model slices. Goal: remove duplicated guard logic while keeping tail latency flat.
devon: Love the idea. main concern is added RPC hop. Any plan to keep hotpath in-proc?
lucy: Plan is hybrid: in-process lightweight hooks for the absolute hotpath (routing hint extraction, quick validation). Sidecar takes async duties: metrics, policy decisions that can be eventual.
priya: How do we handle sequence-affinity and kv-cache locality? Can't centralize the cache.
lucy: Agreed. slim-router will never be authoritative for per-request kv. It will export cache metadata and hints (fingerprints, namespace tags) so services can coordinate without moving their owned store.
devon: Ownership question: who ships this? infra for deployment and scaling, runtime for API and perf contracts?
lucy: Proposed split: infra operates images/rollouts; runtime owns the hook API and perf SLOs. We'll document ownership matrix in the RFC appendix.
priya: Compliance flag: must support tenant-local mode (no telemetry export) for regulated customers. Also need a tenant opt-out.
infra-bot: Created checklist: build, bench, canary automation, and chaos. Link: https://internal.mock/slim-router/checklist
devon: Performance gate idea: if p99 increases by >1.5ms or error-rate rises >0.1% during canary, trigger rollback.
lucy: Migration steps sketch:
1) Spike: prototype shim + async sidecar, perf harness on perf cluster
2) Canary: 1% -> 10% with strict metrics alerts
3) Gradual rollout by route, then cleanup legacy guards
4) Post-cutover 72h observation and kill-switch window
priya: Tests: simulated sidecar outage, degraded network, and token truncation checks. Also test local-only tenants.
devon: I'll own canary automation and alert thresholds. Priya, can you own privacy & tenant gating?
priya: Yes. I'll draft the privacy checklist and tenant list for local-only.
infra-bot: Chaos run scheduled Wednesday 2pm PT on perf cluster.
lucy: I'll kick off spike next week and post numbers here. Keep replies short in this thread so action items don't get lost. :memo:
devon: Sounds good.
priya: On it, will post the privacy PR after spike.
